company_name: Anhui Haitong Semiconductor Technology Co., LTD
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company produces advanced materials and components essential for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Anhui Haitong Semiconductor Technology Co., LTD specializes in manufacturing advanced materials and components for the semiconductor industry. They produce expanded polytetrafluoroethylene (ePTFE) membrane products, PTFE filters, PVDF ultrapure pipelines, and precision machined parts, which are critical for filtration and various semiconductor manufacturing processes.
capabilities: PVDF ultrapure pipelines and pipe fittings
